text:
### Mission  
Detect, prevent, and report financial crime, including money laundering, fraud, and sanctions violations.
name: Chunk 36/102

raw_entities.name: Financial Crime
raw_entities.description: The category of illicit financial activities that FirstUK Bank is obligated to detect, prevent, and report, encompassing money laundering, fraud, and sanctions violations.
context: Detect, prevent, and report financial crime, including money laundering, fraud, and sanctions violations.

raw_entities.name: Financial Crime Detection Obligation
raw_entities.description: The regulatory and operational obligation for FirstUK Bank to actively detect instances of financial crime including money laundering, fraud, and sanctions violations.
context: Detect, prevent, and report financial crime, including money laundering, fraud, and sanctions violations.

raw_entities.name: Financial Crime Prevention Obligation
raw_entities.description: The regulatory and operational obligation for FirstUK Bank to implement controls and measures to prevent financial crime including money laundering, fraud, and sanctions violations.
context: Detect, prevent, and report financial crime, including money laundering, fraud, and sanctions violations.

raw_entities.name: Financial Crime Reporting Obligation
raw_entities.description: The regulatory obligation for FirstUK Bank to report detected instances of financial crime, including money laundering, fraud, and sanctions violations, to the appropriate authorities.
context: Detect, prevent, and report financial crime, including money laundering, fraud, and sanctions violations.
